terms.definition: The organ of hearing and balance.
terms.function: Gathers sound, turns it into signals, and senses balance.
terms.whereItIs: On the sides of the head.
terms.whyItMatters: It lets you hear the world and stay balanced.

terms.definition: The thin membrane that vibrates with sound waves.
terms.whereItIs: At the end of the ear canal.
terms.whyItMatters: It is the first thing sound sets moving.

terms.definition: The coiled inner-ear structure that turns vibrations into signals.
terms.function: Converts mechanical vibration into nerve signals.
terms.whyItMatters: It is where sound becomes a signal.

terms.definition: The inner-ear loops that sense movement and position.
terms.whyItMatters: They are the body's balance sensors.
